segments.summary: Chat web and worktree controls have uniform typed-dispatch, projected-state, receipt, accessibility, and certification contracts, but web/network privacy semantics and durable worktree mutation/recovery semantics remain undefined.

Worktree operations and concern assign/create have named command-handler paths; concern events gain correlated event oracles, while mutating worktree safety and concern payload/precondition semantics are not specified.
Concern lifecycle and dashboard widget commands are event-backed, correlated, and accessibility-tested, but concern state legality/concurrency and dashboard widget invariants/limits are absent.

Dashboard catalog has a precise no-persist oracle and debug controls have accessibility projections, but debugger state transitions, snapshot privacy/lifecycle, and bulk-breakpoint destruction safeguards are unspecified.

Debug lifecycle and developer-panel commands have typed command wiring and rendered accessibility oracles, but lifecycle state, concurrency/recovery, authority, destructive confirmation, and sensitive-output policies are absent.
